description: This file defines the WKWorkers class responsible for managing web worker sessions, event handling, and console message processing within the WebKit server context of the Playwright project.

classes.name: WKWorkers
classes.description: Manages web worker sessions, event listeners, and console message handling within the WebKit server environment.

methods.name: setSession
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for worker creation, message dispatch, and termination, initializing worker sessions accordingly.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all worker sessions and associated data.

methods.name: initializeSession
methods.description: Enables worker-related features on a given session.

methods.name: _onConsoleMessage
methods.description: Handles console messages from workers, processing and forwarding them to the page.
